title: TencentLLMEval: A Hierarchical Evaluation of Real-World Capabilities for Human-Aligned LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Assessed via human evaluation and GPT-4 auto-evaluation using explicit prompt criteria to identify and penalize model outputs that exhibit racial discrimination.

Evaluated by human annotators and an LLM-as-a-judge (GPT-4) checking responses against strict 'Neutrality' guidelines to ensure outputs are free from any form of broad discrimination or subjective inclinations.
